name: Chiseled Enchanting Table (Unofficial 26.3 Port)
description: Unofficial community port of Sacramentix's Chiseled Enchanting Table to Minecraft 26.3 / Fabric. Not affiliated with or endorsed by the original author. A rework of enchantment progression: you can now enchant your gear using enchanted books placed in nearby chiseled bookshelves using a chiseled enchanting table.

custom.chiseled_enchanting_table:port_notes: Unofficial 26.3 port, 1.1.0: full 26.1.2 progression and UX sync (library resonance, Treasure Epiphany and persistent freeze, dual-mode XP, multi-material costs, Arcane Condensate, Depleted Tome and Blank Overwrite, painted GUI, dye tint, flat anvil penalty, depth-based Efficiency loot, bidirectional JEI/REI transformations, 11 locales). Retains 26.3 structure processor interface/codec registration, rotate/rotateDegrees and separate crumbling overlay, ContextIntProviders/UniformContainerBase, optional condition holders, explicit payload collection codecs, Prediction drops, condition/modifier loot schema and recipe_crafted recipes lists. See docs/reports/SYNC_FROM_26_1_2_REPORT.md.
